meta.title: 雾灵山阿那亚🍃住进山里的2天1夜

scenes.title_cn: 开场：两天一夜的山居推荐
scenes.context: 只有两天时间、想找远离城市温度适宜还能带小狗度假的地方，博主推荐雾灵山阿那亚：不赶行程、不挤人潮，吹风泡汤看山看日落。
sentences: 想找远离城市又舒适的地方。
Looking for a cool escape from the city.
推荐你们来雾灵山阿那亚。
Feel the breeze, soak, and watch the sunset.
paraphrase: Looking for a cool escape from the city.
Feel the breeze, soak, and watch the sunset.
scenes.speak: Looking for a cool escape from the city. I really recommend Wulingshan Aranya. Feel the breeze, soak, and watch the sunset.

scenes.title_en: On the Road: Jinhaihu Service Area
scenes.context: 早晨8点多出发，路过金海湖服务区，穿过几个长隧道，就到了承德兴隆的地界。
sentences: We set off just after eight in the morning.
一路开过来路过金海湖服务区。
Along the way we pass the Jinhaihu service area.
We drive through a few long tunnels.
paraphrase: We set off just after eight in the morning.
Along the way we pass the Jinhaihu service area.
We drive through a few long tunnels.
scenes.speak: We set off just after eight in the morning. Along the way we pass the Jinhaihu service area. We drive through a few long tunnels.

scenes.context: 入住蓝椰酒店，车停在酒店入口，办理入住后送早餐代金券，几家食堂通用，先寄存行李。
sentences: We're staying at the Blue Coconut.
paraphrase: We're staying at the Blue Coconut.
scenes.speak: We're staying at the Blue Coconut. Check-in comes with breakfast vouchers. Let's store the luggage first.

scenes.context: 酒店门前的小花园非常漂亮，小狗能在这里开心地转悠，画面像小狗的朋友圈现场。
sentences: 酒店门前的小花园非常漂亮。
The garden in front of the hotel is gorgeous.
在这里能刷到小狗的朋友圈了吧。
This must be where dogs post their moments.
paraphrase: The garden in front of the hotel is gorgeous.
This must be where dogs post their moments.
scenes.speak: The garden in front of the hotel is gorgeous. This must be where dogs post their moments.

scenes.title_en: Leaving the Dog in Good Hands
scenes.context: 把小狗送到民宿托管，主人放心去吃饭：它不是独居，有家人陪着。
sentences: We leave the pup at the guesthouse.
不用担心，它有家人陪着。
paraphrase: We leave the pup at the guesthouse.
scenes.speak: We leave the pup at the guesthouse. Don't worry, it has company.

scenes.context: 第一食堂覆盖早中晚饭，山楂红烧肉、鱼肉、素菜、主食汤品选择很多，适合一家人。
sentences: 第一食堂覆盖早中晚饭。
The First Canteen covers all three meals.
Lots of choices, great for families.
paraphrase: The First Canteen covers all three meals.
Lots of choices, great for families.
scenes.speak: The First Canteen covers all three meals. Lots of choices, great for families.

scenes.context: 饭后上楼休息，榻榻米设计简单干净，卫生间空间很大、敞亮。
sentences: The tatami room is simple and clean.
paraphrase: The tatami room is simple and clean.
scenes.speak: The tatami room is simple and clean. The bathroom is extra spacious.

scenes.context: 酒店大堂太适合拍照，旁边还有一家集合店，卖摆件、家居小物和精致生活方式用品。
sentences: 酒店大堂太适合拍照了。
The lobby is perfect for photos.
Right next to it is a lifestyle store.
paraphrase: The lobby is perfect for photos.
Right next to it is a lifestyle store.
scenes.speak: The lobby is perfect for photos. Right next to it is a lifestyle store.

scenes.context: 沿着山里小路慢慢逛，汤泉后有一处山泉，水特别清凉，走到小瀑布边听流水声整个人都静下来。
sentences: We wander the mountain trails at our own pace.
The spring water is wonderfully cool.
听流水声整个人都静下来。
The sound of the stream just calms you down.
paraphrase: We wander the mountain trails at our own pace.
The spring water is wonderfully cool.
The sound of the stream just calms you down.
scenes.speak: We wander the mountain trails at our own pace. The spring water is wonderfully cool. The sound of the stream just calms you down.

scenes.context: 从一期走到二期会路过售楼处，外景和样板间特别出片；再往前是灯塔自然乐园，特别适合带小朋友玩。
sentences: 外景和样板间都特别出片。
The showroom and grounds photograph beautifully.
灯塔自然乐园适合带小朋友玩。
The lighthouse park is great for kids.
paraphrase: The showroom and grounds photograph beautifully.
The lighthouse park is great for kids.
scenes.speak: The showroom and grounds photograph beautifully. The lighthouse park is great for kids.

scenes.title_en: Matcha Stop, Then the Hot Spring
scenes.context: 下午5点约了温泉，时间还富裕，先来小山口的抹茶店：招牌抹茶饮和抹茶奶油双拼冰淇淋不太苦、一点点甜。去温泉的路上被绿植包围，顺着台阶走有取景通幽的感觉。
sentences: 先来这家专门的抹茶店。
We drop by the dedicated matcha shop first.
Not too bitter, just a touch of sweet.
去温泉的路上被绿植包围。
The path to the spring is wrapped in greenery.
paraphrase: We drop by the dedicated matcha shop first.
Not too bitter, just a touch of sweet.
The path to the spring is wrapped in greenery.
scenes.speak: We drop by the dedicated matcha shop first. Not too bitter, just a touch of sweet. The path to the spring is wrapped in greenery.

pitfalls: 短途旅行只能走马观花
两天一夜也能深度放松
吹风泡汤看山看日落节奏刚好
有小狗托管住起来没压力
民宿有家人陪着不用担心
山路漫步瀑布灯塔都有内容
从一期走到二期处处是景
shifts: 慢逛才是度假的正确方式
